item.title: Budget 2026: Nirmala Sitharaman unveils Semiconductor Mission 2.0, widens chip push to equipment, materials and IP
item.description: The government also increased the allocation for the Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme to Rs 40,000 crore

item.title: Union Budget 2026: FM announced Rs 12.2 lakh cr capex; infra stocks zoom up to 16%
item.description: Infrastructure stocks gained momentum on Sunday after the finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a capital expenditure fund of Rs 12.2 lakh crore for the year 2026-27.

item.title: Budget 2026: Raymond, Gokaldas Exports, KPR Mill, Vardhman Textiles shares rise up to 8%; here's why
item.description: Budget 2026: Gokaldas Exports shares rose 5% to Rs 581.90, Raymond shares climbed 8.18% to Rs 410.85 and KPR Mill Ltd gained 6% to Rs 919.20 .

item.title: Budget 2026: PFC, REC shares jump today; here is the trigger
item.description: In her Budget speech, Nirmala Sitharaman announced plans to introduce a market-making framework for the corporate bond market, aimed at improving liquidity and depth.

item.title: NRI taxes: Budget 2026 proposes simplification of TDS process for inland property sales
item.description: FM Sitharaman also proposed a six-month disclosure window for small taxpayers—such as students, technology professionals and relocated NRIs—to voluntarily declare foreign assets and regularise their tax compliance.

item.title: Budget 2026: Govt raises capex to Rs 12.2 lakh crore, bets Big on Tier II, III infrastructure
item.description: Presenting the Budget, she said public capex has risen sharply over the past decade, from about ₹2 lakh crore in 2014–15 to ₹11.2 lakh crore in the Budget Estimates for FY26, and the proposed hike for FY27 is aimed at maintaining this momentum.

item.title: Union Budget 2026-27: FM extends Lakhpati Didi scheme, 'She-Mark' badge announced to boost women entrepreneurs
item.description: Union Budget 2026: In a key announcement aimed at moving women beyond income-linked livelihood models, Sitharaman said she would extend the Lakhpati Didi programme

item.title: Budget 2026: FM Sitharaman announces customs duty relief for defence aircraft repair, training planes
item.description: Union Budget 2026: FM Sitharaman said the government will provide basic customs duty exemptions on raw material for aircraft repair in the defence sector

item.title: Budget 2026, stock market: Sensex, Nifty plunge 2% after STT hike on F&O trades
item.description: At 12:24 am, the BSE Sensex plunged 789.02 points, or 0.96%, to 81,480.76. The NSE Nifty slipped 278.40 points, or 1.10%, to 25,042.25.
